objective: test whether full ESM-C 6B mutant-minus-WT residue embeddings make the conservatively reconstructed Muk et al. GPCR thermostability matrix transferable to an unseen receptor

source.caveat: Figure S2 preserves receptor-specific binary TM labels rather than the complete continuous 1,231-mutant measurement table. Ten gray shared generic positions were excluded because receptor attribution is not recoverable.

encoder.residue_policy: final-layer contextual mutant-minus-WT residue delta; biological position 1 maps to token 1 after BOS

evaluation_policy.inner_selection: select representation and logistic-regression regularization using only the remaining receptors
evaluation_policy.classifier: standardization, fixed-dimensional PCA, class-balanced logistic regression

representations.base_latent: general stability latent, prediction, and delta norm; 130 columns, PCA-64
representations.mptherm_latent: MPTherm latent plus compact thermodynamic scores; 132 columns, PCA-64
representations.all_latents: general, ProTherm, and MPTherm latents plus compact scores; 388 columns, PCA-64

evaluation_policy.independent_gate_policy: do not consult C5aR or the GPCR-tm official test unless whole-receptor transfer exceeds the prior 600M result

decision.reason: the best fixed 6B configuration is below the prior 600M macro AUC, and nested selection is effectively chance on unseen receptors
